real_analysis.executive_summary:
Publishing: 14 tracked posts from Moburst in this period, compared with 18 in the previous equal-length period.

Engagement: 0.13% is Moburst's average engagement rate per post on RivalIQ-tracked networks (excluding LinkedIn), versus 0.03% previously.

Audience: 7,647 followers across tracked networks (excluding LinkedIn), up 9 from the previous period.

Peer activity: 31 tracked posts makes SplitMetrics a publishing-volume leader among the selected competitors for this period.

gaps_for_client.gap: Build a repeatable “series ladder” on LinkedIn
gaps_for_client.suggested_play: LinkedIn: launch 1 named monthly series, then post a 3-step ladder (announce, reminder, recap) every month; target 0.20% engagement rate per post.
gaps_for_client.why_it_matters: Phiture and Gummicube sustain attention by reusing the same topic across multiple posts, while posting volume is lower here.

gaps_for_client.gap: More LinkedIn volume to match category pacing
gaps_for_client.suggested_play: LinkedIn: add 2 posts/week (1 carousel, 1 image) for 4 weeks; target 16 posts/month and track impressions per post.
gaps_for_client.why_it_matters: SplitMetrics and Gummicube create more surface area with 14–19 LinkedIn posts, while this sample shows 11.

gaps_for_client.gap: Turn Instagram into a weekly carousel lane
gaps_for_client.suggested_play: Instagram: publish 1 carousel/week repurposed from the top LinkedIn POV; target 0.25% engagement rate per post and steady impressions per post.
gaps_for_client.why_it_matters: Instagram shows stronger average rate here, but only 2 posts ran, limiting learning and repeat reach within that feed.

gaps_for_client.suggested_play: Facebook: post 1 photo/link update weekly repurposed from LinkedIn; target non-zero engagement on 3 of 4 posts and monitor impressions per post.
gaps_for_client.why_it_matters: SplitMetrics maintains ongoing Facebook posting while only 1 post ran here, reducing share of voice on that network.

posting_time_insights.summary: Posting is clustered into business-hour blocks, so small shifts in hour testing can help avoid competing with the set’s heaviest weekday windows.

winner_teardown.evidence: Multiple posts promote Growth Phestival follow-up and “Phield Notes” with repeated event framing and CTAs.
winner_teardown.pattern: Run recurring “series” announcements: launch post, reminder post, then recap with a named series title.

winner_teardown.evidence: Several posts reuse the same webinar theme and CTA language across multiple dates with consistent branding.
winner_teardown.pattern: Repeat a webinar promo ladder: save-the-date, “1 week away,” then day-of post using the same expert/topic.

winner_teardown.evidence: Event/insight themes appear as LinkedIn posts and also show up as Facebook photo/link updates in the period.
winner_teardown.pattern: Cross-post the same narrative across LinkedIn and Facebook: event recap or insight, then link out for depth.
